open MeasureTheory
def IsCoupling {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    (γ : Measure (α × β)) (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) : Prop :=
  γ.fst = μ ∧ γ.snd = ν
definition_context: Measures take values in the nonnegative extended reals. IsProbabilityMeasure η is a Prop-valued typeclass asserting that η assigns mass one to the whole underlying space.
For a measure η on a product measurable space, η.fst and η.snd are its pushforwards under the first and second coordinate projections.
IsCoupling γ μ ν is the conjunction γ.fst=μ and γ.snd=ν, as defined in the given Lean context.
